_comment: Human correction layer for autotune. Entries here override whatever autotune crawls.

hotdog casings.reason: 50g carbs per 100g is wrong — collagen/natural casings are not high-carb

rosé sauce.reason: Too vague — autotune maps to aliños sauce values (na=3200mg, sg=10.3). Dropped manually.

leftover rosé sauce.reason: Overly specific leftover key, same bad values as rosé sauce.

sauces.reason: Too generic — autotune assigns arbitrary sauce values.

seasoning mixture.reason: Too generic — no meaningful nutrition data possible.

seasoning powder.reason: Too generic — no meaningful nutrition data possible.

magic sauce.reason: Vague recipe-specific sauce name, garbage values (sg=47.1).

oreos and for topping.reason: Measurement fragment key, not an ingredient name. Use oreo crumbs instead.

active and bubbly sourdough starter.reason: Overly specific key + wrong values (p=40.4g protein). Use sourdough starter.

everything but the bagel seasoning.reason: Missing all macros (p/c/f=0), only na=5900. Incomplete data.

low calorie tortillas.reason: f=19.2g fat — not low calorie. Autotune data is wrong.
